name: Goose Remote by LeanZero
subtitle: Your Mac’s AI agents, anywhere
promotional_text: Follow Goose sessions across your Macs. Read updates, send a nudge and manage remote model downloads from your iPhone or iPad.
description:
Check what your Goose agents are doing and send the next instruction from your iPhone or iPad.

Goose Remote connects to your Macs through LeanZero Link. Open a session, read its activity and continue the conversation while the work stays on its original Mac. Closing the phone app does not stop that work.

See sessions from your linked Macs in one place. Each session shows which Mac owns it and which controls are available. Send a message or steer an active session, then check the owner’s delivery status.

Start Hugging Face model downloads on a selected Mac and check their progress. View node resources and manage supported AI provider settings. Downloads use the selected Mac’s configured storage. Sessions use that Mac’s configured AI provider; your phone and tablet remain controllers.

Use manual sync to refresh your registered Macs. If a Mac cannot be reached, the app shows that separately from the Macs that respond. You can use more than one controller, with layouts for iPhone and iPad and support for light and dark appearance.

Requirements: a compatible Goose Swarm build with remote-controller support, a LeanZero Link account and an online owner Mac. Remote management must be enabled on that Mac for control and configuration changes. The app does not move running sessions between computers or run AI models on iOS.

Your Mac may send session content to its configured AI and tool services. Review the sharing information before sending an instruction. Provider accounts and any provider charges are separate from Goose Remote.
